currentPreparation.campaignContext: The Underwood Stakes win moved Birdman into Cox Plate calculations. Racing.com reported the Cox Plate at Flemington as the immediate major target context after the win, with stable commentary suggesting 2000m may suit him better than 2400m.
currentPreparation.cupStatusNote: Birdman remains part of the fixed 101 original 2026 Melbourne Cup nomination universe. This file does not alter his separately stored official Cup weight or ballot record.

ratings.note: No rating is inferred from the Underwood evidence. Existing verified rating records elsewhere in the repository remain authoritative within their own labelled systems.
